cohort: 427 women with multiple pregnancies who delivered at a gestational age of more than 20 weeks between January 1, 2012 and December 31, 2021 at Khon Kaen University, Faculty of Medicine, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology in Thailand.
finding: The prevalence of multiple pregnancies was 1.99%, with 65.1% resulting in preterm births.
